summary: Second iteration focused on newly added AI Chatbot (Gemini 3 Flash via emergentintegrations) + Admin Dashboard, plus regression on About/Contact copy. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases pass — added Admin (login OK/401, GET /api/admin/leads with/without token, PATCH admin/leads/{id} for contacted flag with persistence) and Chat (POST /api/chat returns non-empty reply, GET /api/chat/{session_id} returns >=2 messages, 422 on short session_id). Frontend: /admin login form + wrong-password error + dashboard with leads table + refresh + toggle contacted (persists across reload) + Export CSV button all work end-to-end. Chat widget opens from floating toggle on every page, sends messages, and Gemini replies land within ~10-20s (visually verified — 2 assistant replies rendered in the panel for 'What is SIP?' and 'How do I start one?'). About /about hero updated correctly: contains 'One trusted desk.' / 'For every financial' / 'decision.' plus Pune/SEBI/AMFI/IRDAI/RERA in the paragraph, and NONE of the forbidden strings ('Twenty-five years', 'Bandra', 'private-banking standards', 'single-desk practice') remain. Contact /contact map iframe src is now 'https://www.google.com/maps?q=Wadgaon+Sheri,+Pune+411014&output=embed' — no Bandra reference.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin auth uses the raw ADMIN_PASSWORD as the bearer token in X-Admin-Token. Fine for a single-admin marketing site as documented, but for hardening consider a random per-session token stored in DB with TTL — the current design means anyone who intercepts the header effectively has the admin password.

/api/chat replays prior history by re-sending every past user message via chat.send_message() before the new turn. This works, but it produces N extra LLM calls per request (cost + latency scales linearly with history length). Consider using the SDK's native conversation memory (LlmChat is designed to preserve session state) OR only pass history as system context rather than replaying send_message. Currently mitigated by the 20-message cap.

In /api/chat the DB write uses one `datetime.now(...).isoformat()` string for both the user and assistant rows, so both have the same ts and ordering is preserved only via insertion order. Minor — should compute per-row timestamps for correctness.

ChatWidget renders 'Assistant is typing…' but there's no server-side timeout / retry — if the LLM takes >30s the axios call will hang. Consider adding an axios timeout with a graceful fallback to the WhatsApp CTA.
AdminPage stores the raw admin password in localStorage (`hf-admin-token`) — same trade-off as above; acceptable for v1 but flag it for a future JWT/session-cookie migration.

rca of the issue: No app bugs discovered this iteration. My initial Playwright chat script failed to open the widget because `wait_for_selector('[data-testid="chat-widget-panel"]', timeout=5000)` fired before framer-motion mounted the AnimatePresence child; also I mistakenly called the toggle twice which closed the panel. Fixed by dispatching click via page.evaluate and verifying panel presence in DOM before sending. Root cause of the false 'no reply' counter: I compared bubbles length against a stale prev count and framer-motion's motion.div children rendered fine but the polling loop's inner_text() call retrieved a cached body-string snapshot before scrolling to the newest message — screenshot at end confirmed 2 assistant replies arrived. No code fix required.
